( Case study 03 )Fintech · Prediction markets

Omnibook

Brand films and founder-led content for the world’s first agentic exchange for prediction markets — from early traction to funding.

Client
Omnibook
Sector
Fintech · Prediction markets
Platforms
Brand & founder channels
Services
Brand videos, Founder-led content, Explainers, Social growth

03Brand videosExplaining the product & vision
04Founder-ledContent from the team building it
( Overview )

Omnibook is building the world’s first agentic exchange for prediction markets — a genuinely new idea, in a category most people are only beginning to understand. We became their content team: brand videos that explain what Omnibook is, and founder-level content that shows who is building it.

( 01 — The challenge )

New categories have a trust problem. Prediction markets are unfamiliar, and “agentic exchange” is a concept few people had heard of. Omnibook needed to look credible to users, partners and investors at the same time — and to build traction before it had a large marketing budget.

( 02 — Our approach )
  1. 01

    Brand videos

    Films that explain the product and the vision simply: what an agentic exchange is, why it matters for prediction markets, and why Omnibook is the team to build it.

  2. 02

    Founder-level content

    A steady stream of founder-led content — perspectives, product thinking and market takes — putting a credible, human face on a new category.

  3. 03

    Explain, then amplify

    Short cut-downs, explainers and timely takes around real-world events kept Omnibook in the conversation and its story easy to share.

  4. 04

    One story, three audiences

    The same narrative shaped for users, the industry and investors, so every piece worked as marketing and as credibility at once.

( 03 — What we made )
  • Brand videos
  • Founder-led videos
  • Product explainers
  • Short-form cut-downs
  • Social content
( 04 — The results )

The content gave Omnibook a clear, credible story in a brand-new category — and growing traction to go with it. Omnibook has since raised funding, and keeps building in public with a content engine that grows alongside the company.

  • Raised a funding round
  • A clear, credible brand story in a brand-new category
  • Founders established as visible voices in prediction markets
  • Growing traction across its channels
( Key learnings )
“In a new category, the story is the product’s first feature. Explain it clearly, and put the founders in front of it.”
